_readme: All calculator prices live here. Summer venue hire, feasting, tableware and the payment plan come from the owner's notes of 22 November 2026 and The Styal Guide; the winter collection from the Styal Lodge pricing guide. All prices include VAT. Drinks are priced separately and are not part of the calculator.
